comparison_plan.recipe: NO_RECIPE (diagnosis/RECIPE_SELECTION.json): no recipe passed gates G1-G3 on both diagnostic partitions (every rule selected identity on D1, whose refitted witness misses the men's reserve; the nonzero ensemble selections on D0 crossed the reserve on CHECK). With no selected recipe, rungs 2-5 of the claim ladder cannot be claimed; the repair panels answer question A on reserved households and describe every frozen rule and the matched frontier.
comparison_plan.E1_transfer: cts.select check (realized CHECK and MODEL_SELECT outcomes of every frozen selection), cts.trackf ladder --check (CHECK and MODEL_SELECT costs at all 11 ladder strengths) and cts.questiona run (OOF vs GUARD prediction of CHECK: PREDICTION_IMPROVED label, RULES.md section 6) for REFIT_PAIR, REFIT_LOC, REFIT_CONT (full and ens) and REFIT_PAIR_TR (full) on R0 and R1
comparison_plan.E2_utility: realized MODEL_SELECT outcomes of every selection (8 occupation-side conditions: reserve and point crossings); Track R complete releases (H3R and HCR income with the refitted witness): 12 clauses + 2 guards per seed and the whole-release reserve
comparison_plan.E3_protection: R reader bank R_FRONTIER (stage R; R0 -> seed-0 cells, R1 -> seed-1 cells; registered grid R1 / R2 x k0 / k1): the witness; REFIT_PAIR, REFIT_LOC and REFIT_CONT at the common strengths 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0 and at every nonzero rule selection on both R partitions; compression twins matched on GUARD utilization to REFIT_PAIR at those strengths (refused for an infinite target); the six required comparators (cached). Stability over the 8 cells per comparison; the old per-cell recipient gate and AGG1 beside each other; the matched frontier (realized MODEL_SELECT reserve use vs pair AUC)
comparison_plan.claim_ladder: cts.rules.claim_ladder: rung 1 (improved cost prediction on D0, D1, R0, R1) is evaluated for the REFIT directions; rungs 2-5 are NOT_CLAIMABLE under NO_RECIPE and are described only; joint design NOT_CLAIMABLE; novelty NOT_CLAIMED
comparison_plan.track_r: refitted H3-recipe income (H3R) and task-only twin (HCR) on R0 / R1 with the refitted witness; REFIT_PAIR_TR selections, realized outcomes and question A; a recipe test on different training subsets, not confirmation of the frozen H3 package
comparison_plan.readers_after: screen operating-characteristic study completed and reviewed (SCREEN_REVIEW.md) before any new release was scored

notes: No direction redesign: the diagnosis locates the binding constraint in the refitted witnesses' baseline slack (training-size effect, F2) and in the sampling noise of SEX-group costs (F4-F5), not mainly in the direction's group allocation; a redesign card was therefore not written.
The adaptive training-size diagnostic (amendment 9: P70, P70A) is outside the repair comparison and cannot change any of its labels.
